rotations.title: Compare rotation strategies
rotations.intro: Each strategy is scored for the priorities set for this farm, under the scenario above. Read the gaps and risks before you decide.
rotations.empty: No rotation strategies are available for this farm yet.
rotations.order: Strategies are listed from the highest score to the lowest. A higher score does not mean a strategy is right for your farm: check each one with a local expert.

rotations.omitted_other: {{count}} strategies were left out because they are missing reasons, evidence, benefits, gaps or risks.

rotations.topScore: Highest score for the priorities you set

drawer.intro: Everything below comes from a rule-based comparison that uses a provisional table of crop traits. The traits have not been reviewed by an agronomist yet. Use this as support for your decision, and check it with a local expert before you change what you plant.
drawer.noLink: No link is available for this source.
drawer.termsHint: Hover, focus or tap a term to see what it means.
drawer.glossaryNote: These plain-language definitions are drafts and still need an agronomist's review.

evapotranspiration.label: Evapotranspiration
evapotranspiration.definition: The water that leaves the field in two ways at once: it evaporates from the soil and the crop's leaves release it as vapor. It is measured in millimeters (mm) of water, like rain.

ndvi.label: NDVI
ndvi.definition: A vegetation index: a number from satellite images that shows how green and healthy the plants in a field look. Low values mean bare soil or stressed plants, high values mean thick, healthy plants.

soil_moisture_anomaly.label: Soil moisture anomaly
soil_moisture_anomaly.definition: How much wetter or drier the soil is than it usually is at this time of year. A negative value means drier than normal.

frost_risk.label: Frost risk
frost_risk.definition: The chance that temperatures fall low enough to damage crops. It depends on the place and on the season, so local knowledge matters.

water_balance.label: Water balance
water_balance.definition: Rain and irrigation that come in, minus the water the crops and soil use up or lose. When more leaves than comes in, plants can run short.

priorities.title: Your priorities for this farm
priorities.intro: Tell us what matters most. These values change the scores in the comparison below. They are saved for this farm only.
priorities.starting: All priorities start at 50 out of 100. Use Reset to defaults to go back to the starting values.
priorities.decision: The scores support your decision. They do not replace your own knowledge or a local expert.
priorities.weightsLegend: How much does each one matter?
priorities.scale: 0 means it does not matter, 100 means it matters most.

water_use.hint: Prefer strategies that use less water.

income.hint: Prefer strategies with more expected income.

soil_structure.hint: Prefer strategies that keep the soil loose, covered and alive.

forage_value.hint: Prefer strategies that give feed for animals.

nitrogen_fixing.hint: Prefer crops that add nitrogen to the soil, so you need less fertilizer.

erosion_reduction.hint: Prefer strategies that keep soil from washing away.

market_suitability.hint: Prefer crops that are easy to sell in your area.

water.label: Water available
water.hint: Choose Low if water is limited on your farm. The comparison then favors strategies that need less water.

equipment.hint: Tick everything you can use. You can leave all of them empty.

priorities.saved: Priorities saved. The comparison is updating.
priorities.saveError: We could not save your priorities. Your changes are still here. Try again.
priorities.resetDone: Priorities reset to the starting values. Save to keep them.

uploads.title: Upload your farm data
uploads.intro: Send a CSV or GeoJSON file with your parcels and seasons. The server checks it and stores the rows that pass.
uploads.notice: Uploaded data is checked and stored, but it is not used yet. Recommendations, scenarios and model results do not change because of it. This tool supports decisions and does not replace local agronomic judgment.

template.heading: Get the template
template.body: The template is a CSV file with one column for each field the server reads. A cell left empty means the value is not known. It is never read as zero.
template.examples: The template has two example rows. Replace the example values with your own data.
template.columns: Dates use YYYY-MM-DD. Numbers use a decimal point. Units: area in ha, yield in kg/ha, rainfall in mm, soil nutrients in mg/kg, organic matter in %.

choose.heading: Choose your file
choose.label: File to upload
choose.hint: CSV (.csv) or GeoJSON (.geojson or .json), up to 2 MB, UTF-8 text.
choose.cannotSend: This file cannot be sent. {{count}} problem(s) stop the whole file.

fileProblem.type: Only .csv and .geojson files can be uploaded (.json is read as GeoJSON).
fileProblem.size: This file is too large ({{size}}). The limit is 2 MB.
fileProblem.encoding: This file is not valid UTF-8 text. Save it as UTF-8 and try again.
fileProblem.read: This file could not be read. Try choosing it again.

review.heading: Check your file
review.rowsRead_one: {{count}} row read: {{valid}} without problems, {{invalid}} with problems.
review.rowsRead_other: {{count}} rows read: {{valid}} without problems, {{invalid}} with problems.
review.clientNote: This check runs in your browser. The server checks the file again and its answer is the one that counts. Rows with problems are not stored.
review.previewHint: Row 1 is the first row below the header. Empty cells are shown as empty and are not read as zero.
review.noneSendable: No row passed the check, so there is nothing to send.

rule.parcel_id: Use 1 to 64 letters, digits, underscores or hyphens.
rule.integer: Use a whole number, for example 2025.
rule.date_invalid: This date does not exist in the calendar.
rule.harvest_before_sowing: The harvest date cannot be before the sowing date.
rule.number: Use a number with a decimal point, for example 2.5.
rule.min: Use a number of at least {{min}}.
rule.max: Use a number of at most {{max}}.
rule.irrigation: Use one of: {{values}}. Or leave it empty.
rule.extra_cells: This row has more cells than the header has columns ({{expected}}). A comma inside text needs quotes.
rule.geometry: The shape must be a closed Polygon or MultiPolygon in longitude, latitude order.
rule.no_rows: The file has no data rows.
rule.unterminated_quote: A quoted cell is never closed.
rule.bad_json: The file is not valid JSON.
rule.features_not_list: The features entry must be a list.
rule.not_feature: This item is not a GeoJSON Feature.

sending.heading: Sending
sending.status: Sending {{name}} ({{size}}). Waiting for the server to check it...
sending.note: The browser does not report how much of the file has left, so this bar does not show a percentage.

error.tooLarge: The server says this file is too large. The limit is 2 MB.
error.rejected: The server did not accept this file: {{message}}
error.maybeStored: The server may have received the file before the connection failed. Check with the team before you send it again.
error.retry: You can send the file again.

result.leadAccepted: The server checked the file and stored every row.
result.leadPartial: The server stored the rows that passed its checks. The rows with problems listed below were left out.
result.leadRejected: No rows were stored. Fix the problems listed below and upload the file again.
result.kept: The server keeps a record of this upload and a copy of the original file.
result.notUsed: Uploaded data is not used yet. Recommendations, scenarios and model results do not change because of this upload.

leaf.title: Check a maize leaf photo
leaf.intro: Upload a clear photo to look for a possible match among supported maize leaf conditions.
leaf.review: Photo screening supports inspection. It is not a confirmed diagnosis and has not been field validated in Guatemala.
leaf.privacy: JPEG or PNG, up to 5 MiB. Your photo is processed for this request and is not saved or used for training.
leaf.uncertain: Could not identify a supported condition
leaf.scoresNote: Model scores are not calibrated probabilities or diagnostic certainty. Other plants and conditions may be misclassified, even with a high score.
leaf.guidanceNote: Guidance references need local review. A photo score does not select a pesticide or a treatment.

errors.type: Choose a JPEG or PNG photo.
errors.size: The photo exceeds 5 MiB. Use a smaller photo.
errors.unavailable: The photo model is not available right now. Try again later.

vegetation.title: Regional vegetation outlook (NDVI)
vegetation.intro: Estimate regional cropland greenness using the rainfall, temperature and ENSO controls above. This is a conditional scenario, not parcel yield, crop growth or an ENSO forecast. The original validation goal was not reached.
vegetation.validation: Whole-year validation ({{years}} years): {{skill}}% improvement against climatology; the {{goal}}% goal was not reached. Interval coverage: {{coverage}}% versus nominal 80%. Annual mean correlation: {{correlation}}. Local review is required.
vegetation.caption: Seasonal peak NDVI anomaly against the cell’s own normal (%)
vegetation.cell: Reference cropland cell: {{cell}}, {{distance}} km from the farm centre; approximately 0.05 degrees. This regional cell includes mixed land cover.
vegetation.outside: Outside training range: {{inputs}}. Treat this estimate with extra caution.
vegetation.attributions: What changed the median model estimate
vegetation.explanation: These SHAP differences explain the raw median model, not causes. Rainfall changes apply uniformly across the season. ENSO phases assume RONI +1, 0 or −1 in seasonal and preseason inputs. Quantile sorting can move the raw median.
vegetation.delta: Explained raw median change: {{delta}} percentage points.
